Zone B · stack position

The Eight Faces of Fi

The canvas draws Fi as a nebula around a core: every experience that enters is weighed against one inner tone. Where Fi sits in a person's stack — the fixed order their eight functions come in — changes how that weighing runs. Click a position to see the change, and drag the maturity slider to watch the lower seats gain fidelity with age.

Zone C · feeder coupling

What Feeds Into Fi?

Fi judges; it does not gather. A perceiving function — its feeder — has to deliver the experiences it weighs, and which one does the delivering changes what the weighing builds. Click a feeder to watch the nebula change shape and motion.

Zone D · verification lab

The Verification Lab

Watch Fi weigh experiences against its one inner standard in real time. Each button sends in a different kind of event — true joy, true grief, flattery, a violation — and the meters track what each one costs.

Click a button to send Fi an experience, and watch it absorb, hold, reject, or bleed around what arrives.
